summary: Iteration 3 focused on the four new requirements (building reference on flats, meter-reading media, categorised maintenance/bill media, free WhatsApp+SMS notify) plus a light regression and the auth playbook checks. Backend: 51/52 pytest cases pass (only the known edge-proxy CORS wildcard case fails, per instructions not re-reported). Frontend: Playwright verified Setup (building dropdown + phones + inline phone edit), Water meter-reading media (multiple files, per-meter isolation, persistence after reload, removal), Charges (3 categorised uploaders + recurring bill photo + table media column via authenticated /api/files), Reconcile notify (wa.me URL with 91-prefixed number and row-accurate message, sms: URL with same body, zero server-side calls), and mobile 390x844. All four requirements work end-to-end. One real mobile layout defect found (form cards overflow the 390px viewport on Charges and Setup > Flats, pushing the 'Gallery' upload buttons off-screen). All test data created was cleaned up; Sunrise Residency demo totals verified back to 3950 / 0.1646 / 6500 / 8600 / 19050 and the month is still open.

minor.issue: Access-Control-Allow-Origin returned as '*' by the ingress even though CORS_ORIGINS is explicit in backend/.env - app-level config verified correct, environment artefact only (not re-reported per main agent note)

ui_bugs.issue: At 390x844 the page shell overflows horizontally (document.scrollWidth 517 > 390) and the form Card measures 1005px wide, so the right half of Work description / Amount / Date inputs and ALL THREE 'Gallery' upload buttons sit off-screen (button x = -41 after horizontal scroll, right edge 432 > 390). Camera buttons are reachable, Gallery buttons are not without horizontal scrolling. Root cause: grid children have no min-w-0, so the wide inner charges table stretches the single-column track.

Same root cause at 390px: add-flat-card is 708px wide inside a main with overflow-x-hidden, so the right portion of the Building select / Flat number / Owner phone / Tenant phone inputs is clipped and NOT scrollable (document.scrollWidth stays 390). Fields are still fillable programmatically but visually truncated for a mobile user.

design_issues.screen: Charges (recurring + one-time) and Reconciliation payment form
issues: Date fields use the native browser date picker (<input type="date">) instead of the shadcn calendar component
WhatsApp/SMS buttons are icon-only with a title attribute but no aria-label - screen-reader/accessibility gap
34x34px tap targets on mobile are below the 44px recommendation (the meter-reading camera/gallery buttons are also 34x34)

action_items: Add min-w-0 (and/or wrap the tables in a min-w-0 overflow-x-auto container) on the grid children in Charges.jsx and Setup.jsx so the form cards fit inside 390px - currently the three work-photo 'Gallery' buttons are off-screen on mobile, which breaks requirement 3 on phones.
Optional: replace native <input type="date"> with the shadcn calendar/date-picker on Charges and Reconcile.
Optional: add aria-label to notify-whatsapp-{flat}/notify-sms-{flat} buttons and bump icon tap targets to 40-44px on mobile.

Optional hardening: the flats table 'Building / Flat' cell prints the currently selected property name rather than resolving flat.property_id; correct today because the list is filtered per building, but it would mislabel if a mixed list is ever rendered.
critical_code_review_comments: MediaUpload category filtering is correct (thumbs filter by m.category) and all three adhoc uploaders share one jobMedia array, so the saved charge stores each item tagged bill/in_progress/completed - verified in DB via GET /api/charges.

notify.js waNumber prefixes 91 only for 10-digit inputs and openSms/openWhatsApp are purely client-side; no SMS/paid gateway exists server-side (openapi has no sms/whatsapp/notify path, no twilio/msg91/gupshup reference in server.py).
GET /api/files/{id} accepts the token via ?auth= query param, which puts the JWT into browser history / referrer headers for every thumbnail. Consider short-lived signed URLs instead.

save_readings overwrites media with whatever the client sends (whole-array replace). Acceptable for this UI but a stale tab can silently drop another user's uploaded photos - consider merging by id or an updated_at guard.

PUT /api/flats requires the full FlatIn body; the inline phone edit sends {...f, owner_phone} which includes the server-generated id/created_at fields (ignored). Fine, but a PATCH-style model would be safer.

success_rate.backend: 98% (51/52; only the known edge-proxy CORS case fails)
success_rate.frontend: 95% (all four new features work; 1 mobile layout defect)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified this iteration: building dropdown files flats under the chosen building and the app switches to it (toast 'Flat added to Srinithi Apartments'); Building / Flat labelling present on Setup subtitle, flats table, meters and readings tables; owner/tenant phone persist and the inline flat-phone-edit-{n} saves on blur via PUT /api/flats; meter-reading media (multi-file, camera+gallery, isolation across 101/102/201/202, persistence, removal) all pass; three categorised charge uploaders store category bill/in_progress/completed and the table media column opens via /api/files?auth=; recurring bill photo persists; WhatsApp opens https://wa.me/91XXXXXXXXXX?text=... and SMS navigates to sms:XXXXXXXXXX?&body=... with a body matching the row exactly, with zero POST/PUT to the backend; 'Add owner phone in Setup' shows for Srinithi flats without phones. Regression OK: dashboard/MIS math, tanker tips per-litre, CSV+PDF downloads (mis-2026-08.csv/pdf). Only open item is the mobile grid overflow. To capture the sms: navigation in Playwright use a CDP session (page.context.new_cdp_session) and listen to Page.frameRequestedNavigation - window.location.href cannot be redefined in Chromium.
rca_of_the_issue: Mobile overflow: in Charges.jsx and Setup.jsx the layout is `grid lg:grid-cols-[380px_1fr]`. At <lg the grid collapses to one column, but grid items default to min-width:auto, so the wide data table (min-content > 390px) stretches the single track; the sibling form card inherits that track width (measured 1005px on Charges, 708px on Setup). On Charges the document itself scrolls horizontally (517px); on Setup main's overflow-x-hidden clips the excess instead. Fix: add min-w-0 to the grid children and keep tables inside their own overflow-x-auto wrapper.
